title.zh: 无公理实践判断的独立接续

scope.zh: 后来另行授权的一条研究线；它不撤销条件对齐路线已完成的工作。
scope.en: A later, separately authorized line of work; it does not revoke completed work on the conditional alignment route.

objective.zh: 专注普遍规范奠基：从同一活动中生活、理解、目的、评价与回应的分化，说明修复、开启、限制与结束的规范根据及适用范围，不预设独立事实、价值和行动者再求外部连接。
objective.en: Focus on universal normative grounding: explain grounds and scope of repair, opening, restriction and ending through living, understanding, purposes, evaluation and response differentiating within one activity, without presupposing separate facts, values and agents plus an external connection.

premises.zh: 保留整体关系与真实对手，不能用弱表示中的自由谓词开关否定完整理论。 组织、目的、认识、规范与meta-attractor属于同一个理论，分章及证明范围不建立独立本体。
premises.en: Retain whole relations and substantive rivals; freely toggled predicates in a weaker representation do not refute the fuller theory. Organization, purposes, knowing, normativity and meta-attraction belong to one theory; chapter and proof scopes do not establish separate ontologies.

completion.zh: 完成标准取自原指示和当前目标；已有局部证明不得冒充中心主张完成。
completion.en: Use the original directive and current target; local proofs cannot substitute for the central result.
